title: Spin(2,3) programme maximal no-go and underdetermination atlas
interpretation: Each route records the earliest bridge that fails at the type required for a physical prediction. Later exact mathematics remains valid but cannot repair that upstream break.

routes.name: Standard-Model source-first effective response
routes.established_core: Local external sources coupled to the incidence and B-L currents give a controlled generating functional; vacuum locality and Lorentz covariance yield a real positive two-current spectral measure; the free UV metric is calculable.
routes.first_break: No dynamics or operational coupling uniquely selects and calibrates the incidence/B-L source pair; finite operator mixing and contacts remain scheme data.
routes.smallest_resolving_calculation: Compute the renormalized 2x2 correlator, operator-mixing matrix, Ward completion and finite subtraction prescription for explicitly normalized incidence and B-L sources in one declared Standard-Model scheme.
routes.promotion_test: Use the result without refitting to predict one pole, residue, cross section or sum-rule combination that differs from a generic pair of currents.
routes.falsifier: The calculated correlator has rank one, violates the assumed Ward typing, or every claimed relation can be changed by an allowed finite source redefinition.

routes.name: Furey topology-first Jordan/Spin(2,3) response
routes.established_core: Exact Peirce, exchange and Clifford conditional expectations reach positive H2(R) carriers, and exact orientation-odd witnesses exist.
routes.first_break: More than one completely positive real-axis selector and both global orientations survive; no operator-level map identifies topology faces with physical Standard-Model probes.
routes.smallest_resolving_calculation: Derive from one gauge-invariant action a completely positive source-to-topology intertwiner that preserves the B-L Ward axis, UV metric, contacts and reversal operation.
routes.promotion_test: The derived reversal flips a measured balanced interference observable while all source normalizations cancel.
routes.falsifier: Two inequivalent selectors remain observationally indistinguishable or the intertwiner fails Ward, positivity or dimensional typing.

routes.name: Freudenthal source-response completion
routes.established_core: On a paired H2(R) source-response space the quartic critical locus contains the inverse graph C=lambda A^-1, and a log-determinant variational action realizes that graph.
routes.first_break: The exceptional invariant is homogeneous and fixes neither lambda, the embedding, the real axis nor the orientation; the variational scale is an external coupling or temperature.
routes.smallest_resolving_calculation: Exhibit an additional source-derived term or quantization condition whose stationary equations fix lambda and the physical embedding without importing either as a coefficient.
routes.promotion_test: The fixed scale propagates to a dimensionally normalized observable invariant under allowed source redefinitions.
routes.falsifier: A continuous rescaling orbit remains after all admitted invariants and boundary conditions are imposed.

routes.name: Kantor/structurable oriented parent
routes.established_core: The raw Furey TRO product fails the second Kantor identity; its canonical structurable correction passes and yields explicit classical five-gradings, including so(3,2) only on a real lepton slice.
routes.first_break: The CP pairing that preserves the lepton Jordan graph does not preserve the structurable Kantor product or its Spin(2,3) slice.
routes.smallest_resolving_calculation: Provide a different physically justified involution/product and verify both Kantor identities, Standard-Model gauge covariance, CP covariance and the required grading on the full matter carrier.
routes.promotion_test: Its five-graded action fixes a source selector or orientation observable unavailable in the Jordan shadow.
routes.falsifier: The repaired product again closes only on a classical linking algebra or loses CP/gauge covariance.

routes.name: E7/E8 or exceptional-parent ontology
routes.established_core: Exceptional groups and Freudenthal/Albert structures contain relevant representations and invariant polynomials.
routes.first_break: No explicit intertwiner carries the audited chiral Standard-Model action, its source operators and their normalization into a selected exceptional parent with the correct four-dimensional chirality.
routes.smallest_resolving_calculation: Write the parent action and branching map, then derive rather than insert the mirror projection, hypercharge normalization, Yukawa tensors and low-energy source response.
routes.promotion_test: At least one low-energy dimensionless or dimensionful relation survives threshold matching and differs from a generic grand-unified boundary condition.
routes.falsifier: The construction needs manual mirror removal, arbitrary symmetry-breaking directions or unrestricted threshold corrections that can fit any low-energy value.

routes.name: Passive poles, residues and scattering
routes.established_core: Every finite rational positive matrix response has a passive realization; dual pole weights, time delay and positive residues obey exact response-theory identities.
routes.first_break: The poles and residues are not uniquely tied to Furey-typed Standard-Model thresholds, and the exact laws found so far are generic passive-system identities.
routes.smallest_resolving_calculation: Match the renormalized Standard-Model current correlator to physical asymptotic channels and predict a residue or delay combination with no response-model fit parameters.
routes.promotion_test: A pre-registered scattering or spectral observable agrees with the calculated value and cannot be reproduced by arbitrary positive two-port data.
routes.falsifier: The channel dictionary is basis dependent or all proposed relations follow from generic unitarity, positivity or the Cayley transform.
